reason: I'd probably let them run the free missed-call check, because I'm curious what I'm losing. But paying 99 euros a month so my customers get an automatic text instead of me? My customers want to talk to a person, and I already listen to the mailbox at lunch and WhatsApp people back myself.
objection: My customers want a real person. A text from a machine makes my one-man business look like a call centre, and a brand-new company with no customers handling my calls is a risk I'm not ready to take.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 14-day check shows me real numbers, like several callers a week I lost who never rang back, and a couple of other tradespeople nearby tell me their customers didn't mind the text.
